values: 对目标位置附近的全部敌人造成多次伤害并魅惑敌人。
Mehira deals damage to all enemies in a target area multiple times and charms them.

梅希拉在目标地点生成吻痕，对半径2格范围内的所有敌人冲击6次造成50% + 5% ATK伤害，短暂停顿后，对范围内的敌人强力冲击造成170% + 25% ATK伤害。
受到强力冲击影响的敌人会被魅惑持续3秒。

Mehira marks a target area with her kiss, striking all enemies within 2 tiles 6 times, with each strike dealing 50% + 5% ATK damage. After a short delay, she unleashes a powerful blast in the same area, dealing 170% + 25% ATK damage.
Enemies hit by the powerful blast become charmed for 3s.
强力冲击造成的伤害提升至190% + 25% ATK。
Increases the powerful blast damage to 190% + 25% ATK.
强力冲击造成的伤害提升至210% + 25% ATK。
Increases the powerful blast damage to 210% + 25% ATK.
强力冲击造成的伤害提升至230% + 25% ATK。
Increases the powerful blast damage to 230% + 25% ATK.
强力冲击造成的伤害提升至250% + 25% ATK。
Increases the powerful blast damage to 250% + 25% ATK.
对面前扇形区域造成多次不分敌我的生命流失效果，命中友方时额外提升急速。
Mehira lashes her whip at all units, friend or foe, in a frontal arc, causing HP loss. Allies hit gain Haste.
梅希拉不分敌我地挥动鞭子鞭笞前方半径3格扇形区域内的角色5次，每次鞭笞使其流失20% + 3% ATK的生命。若命中友军，则额外提高其急速25点，持续8秒。该技能对友军造成的生命流失效果降低90%，并且选择能命中最多敌人的方向释放。

Mehira lashes her whip at all units, friend or foe, in a 3-tile frontal arc 5 times. Each hit causes a unit to lose 20% + 3% ATK HP. If an allied unit is hit, they gain 25 Haste for 8s, and their HP loss from this skill is reduced by 90%. Mehira always targets the direction that hits the most enemies.
每次鞭笞造成的生命流失提升至24% + 3% ATK。
Increases the HP loss caused by each whip hit to 24% + 3% ATK.
每次鞭笞造成的生命流失提升至28% + 3% ATK。
Increases the HP loss caused by each whip hit to 28% + 3% ATK.
每次鞭笞造成的生命流失提升至32% + 3% ATK。
Increases the HP loss caused by each whip hit to 32% + 3% ATK.
吸引全场敌人到目标位置附近。
Mehira draws all enemies toward a designated position.
在距离所有敌人最近位置生成梅希拉的幻象诱惑全场敌人，使他们陷入“痴迷”状态并狂热地奔向幻象，持续2.2 + 0.1秒。战斗开始时会立刻在梅希拉对称的位置生成一次幻象。

Mehira summons an illusion of herself on the tile closest to the enemy lineup, bewitching all enemies and making them rush mindlessly toward the illusion for 2.2 + 0.1s. When a battle starts, she summons such an illusion on a symmetrical tile across from where she stands.
“痴迷”状态的持续时间提升至2.3 + 0.1秒。
Increases the duration of the bewitched state to 2.3 + 0.1s.
“痴迷”状态的持续时间提升至2.4 + 0.1秒。
Increases the duration of the bewitched state to 2.4 + 0.1s.
“痴迷”状态的持续时间提升至2.5 + 0.1秒。
Increases the duration of the bewitched state to 2.5 + 0.1s.
战斗中生命汲取提升，恢复一定生命值后可提高攻击力。
Increases Life Drain during battle. Each time the total healing Mehira receives reaches a certain amount, increases her ATK.
生命汲取提高8点，当自身受到任意来源的生命恢复值达到40%初始最大生命值时，提高6%攻击力，最多可提高18%。
Increases Life Drain by 8. Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 6%, up to 18%.
生命汲取提高10点，当自身受到任意来源的生命恢复值达到40%初始最大生命值时，提高8%攻击力，最多可提高24%。
Increases Life Drain by 10. Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 8%, up to 24%.
生命汲取提高12点，当自身受到任意来源的生命恢复值达到40%初始最大生命值时，提高10%攻击力，最多可提高30%。
Increases Life Drain by 12. Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 10%, up to 30%.
召唤使魔在身边持续攻击敌人，在危险时献祭使魔使自身暂时无法被选中并恢复生命。
Mehira summons voidlings that continuously attack enemies. When she's in danger, she sacrifices one to become temporarily untargetable and recover her HP.
战斗开始时，梅希拉召唤3只使魔环绕自身，使魔每1.5秒会攻击敌人造成40% ATK伤害。若梅希拉受到任意伤害后生命值即将低于20%，则献祭一个使魔来抵消本次伤害，并使自身在后续2.5秒内无法被选中、且立刻恢复20%最大生命值。

When a battle starts, Mehira summons 3 voidlings around her. Each voidling attacks an enemy every 1.5s, dealing 40% ATK damage. If Mehira takes a hit that would reduce her HP below 20%, she sacrifices a voidling to block that damage. She then becomes untargetable for 2.5s and instantly recovers 20% of her max HP.
使魔攻击造成的伤害提升至50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each voidling attack to 50% ATK.
使魔攻击造成的伤害提升至60% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each voidling attack to 60% ATK.
梅希拉储存溢出的生命恢复量，每存储相当于50%初始最大生命值的恢复量，便额外召唤一只使魔，每场战斗最多额外召唤3只使魔。
Mehira stores any excess healing she receives. Each time the stored amount reaches 50% of her initial max HP, she summons one extra voidling, up to 3 per battle.
处于自身的魅惑和痴迷效果的敌人受到的伤害增加。
Increases the damage taken by enemies charmed or bewitched by Mehira.
受到技能“往赴极乐”的魅惑效果或技能“魅影狂潮”的痴迷效果影响的敌人，受到的伤害提高15%，该效果不可叠加。
Increases the damage taken by enemies charmed with Mehira's Euphoric Rush or bewitched with her Alluring Mirage by 15%. This effect does not stack.
